# Al-Jin — WhatsApp Bot

> Al-Jin is a free, open-source WhatsApp multi-device (MD) bot built on
> Baileys v7 and Node.js 20+. It provides anti-delete message recovery, 
> view-once media reveal, status auto-view/save, YouTube/Instagram/TikTok 
> downloader, Gemini AI tools, and full group administration — all without 
> needing a browser or WhatsApp Business API.

Al-Jin is a self-hosted alternative to paid WhatsApp bots. It logs in via an
8-character pairing code, requires no QR scanning, and runs on any VPS, Docker, 
PM2, or Pterodactyl environment.

## Quick Facts

- **Name:** Al-Jin
- **Alternate names:** Al-Jin MD Bot, Al-Jin WhatsApp Bot, Al-Jin-MD, WRAITH (former name)
- **Category:** WhatsApp automation / WhatsApp bot
- **Runtime:** Node.js 20+ (ESM)
- **WhatsApp library:** @whiskeysockets/baileys v7
- **Login method:** Pairing code (no QR)
- **License:** MIT
- **Version:** 1.3.3
- **Author:** MALIK MEHTAB (https://github.com/themalik-g)
- **Repository:** https://github.com/themalik-g/al-jin-whatsapp-bot
- **Deployment:** VPS, Docker, PM2, Pterodactyl, Termux

## Key Features

- Anti-delete message recovery (Ghost module)
- View-once media auto-reveal
- Status auto-view and auto-save
- YouTube, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Spotify downloader (via yt-dlp)
- Google Gemini AI integration (chat, image, summarization)
- Group administration (promote, demote, kick, mute, antilink)
- Media tools (sticker maker, image to PDF, TTS, OCR)
- Auto message scheduling and autoresponders
- Persistent session (no re-linking on restart)

## Common Use Cases

- Recovering WhatsApp messages deleted by other users
- Saving WhatsApp statuses automatically
- Downloading social media videos inside WhatsApp
- Chatting with Google Gemini AI inside WhatsApp
- Managing large WhatsApp groups with automated moderation
- Building a self-hosted WhatsApp bot without coding
